description: This source file contains utility functions and API call implementations related to user analytics, such as fetching tenant summaries and active user trends. It includes normalization of query parameters, error handling, and exports of functions for integrating with a backend API.

methods.name: normalizeQuery(params = {})
methods.description: Helper function to process and clean query parameters, converting Date objects to ISO strings and removing undefined, null, or empty string values.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummary(params = {})
methods.description: Fetches a summary of tenant users, with optional filters for date range, status, and inactivity inclusion. Handles API response and errors gracefully.

methods.name: getActiveUsersTrend(params = {})
methods.description: Retrieves a trend of active users over time, with optional parameters for time scope, granularity, status, and tenant scope. Handles errors and returns default values when needed.
